subject: pathology
title: Leukocytosis, Leukaemoid Reaction, LAP Score, and Reactive Lymph Nodes

steps.tx: Leukocytosis is a sign, not a diagnosis: neutrophilia answers bacterial infection, steroids, stress, and necrosis, while lymphocytosis answers viruses and eosinophilia answers parasites, allergy, and drugs. Reading the differential before the total is the discipline of **leukocytosis interpretation**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Never react to the white count alone; the differential tells you which army has mobilised and why.

steps.tx: Neutrophilia with left shift, toxic granulation, and Dohle bodies shows marrow releasing young cells under cytokine pressure, the picture of acute bacterial infection or severe inflammation. The release pattern is a **left shift with toxic changes**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Toxic granulation and Dohle bodies mean the marrow is fighting hard; look for the bacterial source.

steps.tx: When reactive white counts climb into leukaemia ranges above fifty thousand with mature cells and an obvious septic driver, the mimic is called a leukaemoid reaction, and separating it from chronic myeloid leukaemia decides management. The mimic is the **leukaemoid reaction**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Leukaemoid reactions mimic leukaemia counts with mature cells and a septic story; CML is the separation that matters.

vis.caption: Chronic myeloid leukaemia, the neoplasm a leukaemoid reaction must be separated from.

steps.tx: Leucocyte alkaline phosphatase inside neutrophils soars in leukaemoid reactions and pregnancy but collapses in chronic myeloid leukaemia, giving a cheap historical separator now largely replaced by BCR-ABL testing. The enzyme score is the **LAP score (leucocyte alkaline phosphatase)**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: High LAP means reaction, low LAP meant CML; today BCR-ABL testing gives the definitive answer.

steps.tx: Infectious mononucleosis floods blood with atypical lymphocytes, Downey cells, that are actually reactive cytotoxic T cells hunting EBV infected B cells, accompanied by pharyngitis, nodes, spleen, and atypical hepatitis. The impressive atypical cell is a **reactive (Downey) atypical lymphocyte**, not a blast.
steps.say: Downey atypical lymphocytes are reactive T cells, not leukaemia; glandular fever is their classic stage.

steps.tx: Reactive lymphadenitis enlarges nodes through follicular hyperplasia with tingible body macrophages, paracortical expansion, or sinus histiocytosis, patterns that preserve architecture unlike lymphoma effacement. Preserved architecture with polymorphous cells defines **reactive lymph node hyperplasia**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Reactive nodes keep their architecture and mixed cell populations; effacement by monotony warns of lymphoma.

steps.tx: Kikuchi disease necrotises cervical node areas in young women with fever, mimicking lymphoma and tuberculosis microscopically, then resolves spontaneously over weeks, while Rosai-Dorfman disease fills sinuses with huge histiocytes eating lymphocytes. The self limited necrotising entity is **Kikuchi disease (histiocytic necrotising lymphadenitis)**.
steps.say: Kikuchi disease mimics lymphoma under the microscope yet resolves alone; Rosai-Dorfman shows emperipolesis instead.

steps.tx: Agranulocytosis, neutrophils below five hundred from drugs such as antithyroids, clozapine, chemotherapy, or marrow failure, converts mouth ulcers and fever into a neutropenic sepsis emergency needing immediate broad spectrum antibiotics. The emergency threshold state is **agranulocytosis with febrile neutropenia**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Fever with neutrophils under five hundred is an emergency: cultures, broad spectrum antibiotics within the hour.

vis.caption: Acute leukaemia pathophysiology, the marrow failure state reactive counts must be distinguished from.
